---
title: "Notes"
format: html
---

_("Kath has [Issues](https://github.com/kathsherratt/kathsherratt.github.io/issues)")_

```{r}
#| code-fold: true
library(here)
library(gh)
owner <- "kathsherratt"
repo <- "kathsherratt"
issues <- gh("/repos/:owner/:repo/issues",
             owner = owner, repo = repo,
             state = "open", .limit = Inf)

for (issue in issues) {
  date <- strsplit(issue[["updated_at"]], "T")[[1]][1]
  title <- issue[["title"]]
  body <- issue[["body"]]
  cat(paste0("### ", title,  "\n\n"), 
      paste0(date, "\n\n"),
      body, 
      "\n\n---\n\n")
}
```
